What is the difference between a center back, a full-back and a defensive midfielder?

The biggest difference is who you defend. A center back plays in the middle of the back line and deals with the striker. A full-back plays on the side of the back line and deals with the winger. A defensive midfielder plays in front of the center backs and deals with their number 10.

PositionWhereMain opponentMain jobTraditional numbers
Center backMiddle of the back lineThe strikerProtect the area in front of goal, win headers, organize the line4, 5
Full-backLeft or right of the back lineThe wingerDefend the flank, support attacks down the touchline2, 3
Defensive midfielder (the 6)In front of the center backsTheir number 10Screen passes into the striker, start the build-up6

The roles overlap. Many teams drop the defensive midfielder between the center backs when building up, and full-backs often move to center back as they get older. Learning the next role over makes you more useful to a coach.

What should a center back say? 8 calls to use

A center back's calls should be one or two words, loud and early, and each one should tell a teammate exactly what to do. Say it before the ball arrives, not after. The calls below are common, but the exact words matter less than everyone on your team using the same ones.

CallWhenWhat it means
"Step!"The passer is under pressure or the ball goes backwardsThe whole line moves up together
"Drop!"The passer is free with his head upThe line moves back a few yards
"Hold!"You want the line to stay where it isNobody steps or drops
"Man on!"A presser is closing a teammate who can't see himPlay it simple, don't turn
"Time!"Nobody is near the teammate on the ballTake a touch and look up
"Yours!" / "Mine!"A runner moves between two defendersWho marks him from now on
"Away!"The ball has to be clearedHead or kick it high and wide
"Keeper's!"Only the goalkeeper calls thisLeave the ball for him

How do I become a better center back on my own?

Train footwork, passing with both feet against a wall and heading technique in small doses, practice decisions with match pictures, and watch one center back for 15 minutes of a full game.

Who is the best center back in the world right now?

There is no official answer and rankings change every season. Sports Illustrated's ranking, last updated in August 2026, put Pau Cubarsí first, followed by Gabriel Magalhães and William Saliba. For learning, pick one whose build and style are close to yours.

Should a left-footed player play left center back?

It helps. A left-footer at left center back can pass down the left side and switch play without turning back onto his right foot, which makes playing out easier. Plenty of right-footed players play there too, so learn to pass with both feet.

Is a defensive midfielder the same as a center back?

No. A defensive midfielder plays in front of the center backs, screens passes into their striker and helps start attacks. A center back plays in the back line and protects the area in front of goal. Some teams drop the defensive midfielder between the center backs to build up.
